_comment: Chapter 1 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): the morning at home, the last before the raid; it leads to the weapon master's trial.

text.zh_TW: 媽媽：「里歐，起床了！今天是你十二歲生日——還有，你昨晚是不是偷吃了整鍋燉菜？」
text.en: Mom: "Leo, up! It's your twelfth birthday. And did you eat the whole pot of stew last night?"

text.zh_TW: 爸爸：「老鼠會把碗舔得這麼乾淨？」爸爸笑著揉亂你的頭髮。「去吧，武師在村口等你。生日禮物——今天你可以挑第一把武器。」
text.en: Dad: "Mice that lick the bowl this clean?" He ruffles your hair, laughing. "Go on, the weapon master is waiting at the gate. Your present: today you choose your first weapon."

text.zh_TW: 媽媽：「早點回來吃晚飯。還有……不管發生什麼事，都別離你爸太遠。」她的手停在你肩上，比平常久了一點。
text.en: Mom: "Be back for supper. And... whatever happens, stay close to your father." Her hand rests on your shoulder a moment longer than usual.
